visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is seated in a maroon mesh office chair, intensely focusing on a smartphone she holds horizontally. She is wearing a light blue and white vertical striped oversized shirt. As she realizes she has lost the game, her expression shifts from concentration to frustration, her mouth agape in a groan. (2) She looks up towards the person behind the camera, gesturing dramatically with her hands. She starts handing out physical sheets of paper that represent "Report Records" to various imaginary directions, her facial expressions are exaggerated and comical. The room is brightly lit with horizontal blinds in the background. (3) A man's hand reaches into the frame from the right, handing her a final "Report Record". She takes it with a puzzled look. Upon opening it to reveal a reputation score deduction, her eyes widen in a comical shock, followed by a bright smile as she suddenly lunges towards the camera in a playful manner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the woman's high-arousal, sharp-pitched exclamation "又輸" (Lost again), conveying intense frustration. Immediately, an upbeat, moderate-tempo synthesizer-based BGM kicks in. There is the subtle sound of her handling a smartphone and the rustling of clothes as she moves. (2) The female voice transitions into a fast-paced, rhythmic delivery as she lists game roles, her tone becoming comedically authoritative. Audible rustling sounds of paper occur each time she "hands out" a report card. A male voice briefly interjects with a short, confused vocalization as he receives a paper. (3) The male speaker's voice is calm and teasing as he delivers a longer sentence, leading to the woman's surprised and slightly higher-pitched response. As she opens the paper, a comical bubble pop sound effect is heard, followed by her laughter and a playful, high-energy scream as the BGM continues to a hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic sketch satirizes the typical behavior of mobile gamers in Arena of Valor. After losing a match, the main character aggressively 'reports' her teammates for their performance, only to be surprised by a teammate (the person filming) who reveals she was the one reported and received a penalty, ending in a playful confrontation.
